content.summary: Reference list addressing pulmonary embolism and venous thromboembolism (VTE): management, incidence, risk factors, pediatric VTE, cancer-associated VTE, and the role of prothrombotic mutations.
topics: Clinical features and outcomes of pulmonary embolism in children
Venous thromboembolism (VTE) incidence and registries in children
Risk factors and triggers for VTE and hospitalization
VTE in patients with acute leukemia
Incidence and impact of VTE in cancer patients
Association of malignancy and prothrombotic mutations with venous thrombosis
populations: General adult hospitalized populations (triggers of hospitalization)
notable_points: Reference summarizing updated management of pulmonary embolism (Konstantinides et al., 2016).
Multiple studies report incidence, registry data, and outcomes of pediatric VTE (1994–2004 references).
Studies detail risk factors for VTE and triggers of hospitalization (Anderson & Spencer; Rogers et al.).
Papers examine incidence, risk factors, and survival impact of VTE in acute leukemia and other cancers (Ku et al., Chew et al.).
Epidemiology of cancer-associated venous thrombosis reviewed (Timp et al., 2013).
Association between malignancies, prothrombotic mutations, and VTE risk discussed (Blom et al., 2005).
